blurb: Antler Creek Golf Course, El Paso County's finest daily fee golf course, provides an outstanding golf experience at affordable rates. Antler Creek's six sets of tees will provide challenge and enjoyment for every caliber of golfer. This Rick Phelps designed course that opened in 2004, has wide fairways that artistically wind through Woodmen Hills and Meridian Ranch communities.
